summary.business_type: SaaS (B2B automated-response platform) with 9 industry-vertical landing pages, targeting small businesses in Serbia
top_findings:
Pure client-side rendering: homepage + 10 niche pages ship an empty
with no server-rendered content, confirmed via curl and in the dist/ build.
Product-claim vs. search-intent mismatch: niche pages imply live call-answering, but the homepage FAQ admits the voice agent doesn't exist yet; Serbian SERP is dominated by voice-agent competitors.
Identical H2 duplicated across 10 URLs; vertical pages carry only ~150-200 unique words each on a shared template.
Zero trust signals on any vertical page: no FAQ, testimonials, pricing, client logos, About page, or company registration number.
AI Search Readiness (GEO) scores 34/100, driven almost entirely by the CSR issue plus absence of any citable-length (134-167 word) passages.
quick_wins: Defer/lazy-load the LeadConnector chat widget script (largest render-blocking resource, ~1,340ms)
Publish /llms.txt with a plain-text summary of APLORY
Add missing security headers via netlify.toml [[headers]]
Reformat the '62% of missed calls' stat into one fully attributed, disclosed sentence

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt cleanly allows all UAs and correctly declares sitemap.xml
sitemap.xml valid, 15 URLs, sensible priority weighting and lastmod
Every page has correct self-referential canonical, unique title/meta description
Full OG/Twitter tags present as static tags (unaffected by CSR issue)
Clean single-hop HTTPS/www redirects, hyphenated URL structure
Sound cache-control strategy on Netlify; JSON-LD ProfessionalService schema server-rendered on homepage

findings.title:
Homepage and all 10 niche landing pages ship empty
- pure CSR, no SSR/prerendering
findings.description: Confirmed via curl and in both repo source and dist/ build: 11 of 15 sitemap URLs (all commercially important pages) have zero content in raw HTML. Only the 4 legal pages are genuinely static. No SSG/prerendering plugin configured in vite.config.js despite each route already having its own HTML entry point.
findings.recommendation: Add prerendering/SSG (vite-plugin-ssg, vite-plugin-prerender-html, or a custom build-time render step) so each dist/*.html ships fully rendered markup; React can still hydrate on top.

findings.title: No custom security headers beyond default HSTS
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. HSTS present but missing includeSubDomains/preload.
findings.recommendation: Add a netlify.toml [[headers]] block or public/_headers file applied to /* with the missing headers, scoped to allow existing third-party origins (leadconnectorhq.com, fonts.googleapis.com).

findings.title: LCP gated by JS execution, compounding the CSR issue
findings.description: Hero images are correctly dimensioned but can't paint until the JS bundle downloads/parses/executes/hydrates, since they only exist in the DOM post-render.
findings.recommendation: Fixing the prerendering issue resolves most of this; add fetchpriority="high" to the hero image once part of initial render.

findings.title: IndexNow protocol not implemented
findings.description: No IndexNow key file and no post-deploy submission to api.indexnow.org.
findings.recommendation: Add a key file plus a post-deploy hook submitting the 15 sitemap URLs after each Netlify deploy, to speed Bing/Yandex re-crawl.

findings.title: Inconsistent meta name="robots" declaration
findings.description: Only the 4 legal pages explicitly declare meta robots index,follow; no functional difference from the default.
findings.recommendation: Cosmetic only - standardize either way, no priority.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Readability is good - short sentences, concrete scenarios, plain Serbian language
Demo chat transcripts are genuinely vertical-specific and a real trust/experience signal
Homepage FAQ candidly admits the voice-agent feature isn't ready yet - a rare, credible trust signal
62% statistic is at least cited with a working source URL, better than an unsourced claim

findings.title: No FAQ/Q&A content on any of the 9 vertical pages
findings.description: The Faq component only renders on the homepage. Vertical pages have zero structured, quotable Q&A content, the highest-value format for featured snippets and LLM citation.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 vertical-specific FAQ entries per page as prose content (pricing model, integrations, compliance question relevant to that industry).

findings.title: Exact duplicate H2 across 10 pages
findings.description: NichePain.jsx hardcodes the identical sentence as the section heading on all 9 niche pages, and the homepage uses the same sentence for problem.title.
findings.recommendation: Write a distinct, vertical-specific H2 for each niche page using the existing pain-card copy as raw material.

findings.title: No About/company/team page or entity trust signals
findings.description: Only a personal Gmail address and a mobile number are exposed. No founder identity, headcount, testimonials, or third-party recognition anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add an About/Company page with founder details, physical address (currently buried only in legal pages), and PIB/company registration number.

findings.title: Core statistic is old, small-sample, market-mismatched, and undisclosed
findings.description: The 62% headline stat is sourced to a 2016, 85-company U.S. study, presented without disclosure that it isn't Serbian or current data.
findings.recommendation: Either caveat the stat explicitly as a U.S. benchmark, commission Serbia-relevant data, or replace with the company's own aggregated client data.

findings.title: "How it works" explainer 100% identical across all 9 vertical pages and homepage
findings.description: NicheHow.jsx pulls identical eyebrow, title, and step copy from shared sr.js data - nothing niche-specific except the demo chat transcript.
findings.recommendation: Localize at least the three step bodies per vertical.

findings.title: No FAQPage schema despite homepage FAQ content
findings.description: Homepage FAQ has 4 good Q&As but no structured data wrapping it.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema as a content-organization aid only - do not expect a Google SERP benefit, as FAQ rich results were retired May 2026.

findings.title: Thin overall word count relative to search intent
findings.description: Genuinely unique body copy per vertical page is ~150-200 words; sta-radimo.html largely restates homepage copy rather than going deeper.
findings.recommendation: Expand sta-radimo.html with mechanism, SLA, and data-handling depth.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles and meta descriptions per page, appropriately localized
Clean, descriptive, hyphenated URL structure with no query strings
Correct self-referential canonicals across all 15 pages

findings.title: Identical H2 and heading structure across 10 URLs
findings.description: Shared template produces near-identical on-page heading hierarchy across all vertical pages, undermining topical differentiation signals.
findings.recommendation: See Content Quality findings - de-duplicate H2s and localize section copy per vertical.

findings.title: No internal linking depth beyond primary navigation
findings.description: No contextual cross-links between related vertical pages or from blog/resource content (none exists) into the commercial pages.
findings.recommendation: Once content depth increases (FAQ, expanded sta-radimo.html), add contextual internal links between related pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Server-rendered ProfessionalService + OfferCatalog/Service/Offer JSON-LD, valid, no deprecated types
Per-niche-page Service schema referencing the same provider with areaServed: RS

findings.title: Missing image/logo, sameAs, and address properties
findings.description: ProfessionalService schema lacks image, sameAs (social/GBP links), and a PostalAddress, all of which support Knowledge Panel eligibility and entity consolidation.
findings.recommendation: Add image (reuse existing og:image), sameAs with real profile URLs, and address with at least addressCountry: RS.

findings.title: No FAQPage, Review/AggregateRating, or LocalBusiness/GeoCoordinates schema
findings.description: Despite areaServed: RS and the product serving inherently local-service verticals, no LocalBusiness-family schema or review markup exists.
findings.recommendation: Add once testimonials/reviews exist; add LocalBusiness/geo schema given the explicit RS service area.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: LCP 2.0-2.4s (Pass), CLS 0.03-0.07 (Pass), TBT 20-50ms (Pass) across all 3 pages tested, lab data
TTFB excellent (67-184ms) with Brotli and Netlify edge caching confirmed working
No legacy/duplicated JavaScript shipped

findings.title: Third-party chat widget script is the largest render-blocking resource
findings.description: widgets.leadconnectorhq.com/loader.js costs ~1,340ms of blocking time; nearly all LCP time (2,086/2,154ms on homepage) sits in element-render-delay rather than TTFB.
findings.recommendation: Load the chat widget with defer or on user interaction/scroll rather than blocking initial render.

findings.title: Duplicate font loading (Google Fonts + Bunny Fonts) both render-blocking
findings.description: Google Fonts CSS costs ~1,418ms; a separate Bunny Fonts Roboto file costs ~685ms - two font origins loading synchronously ahead of render.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one font provider, ideally self-hosted given the existing self-hosted AdwaitaSans.woff2 precedent.

findings.title: Unoptimized logo-mark.png
findings.description: 19.6KB of the file's 20.9KB is wasted - 2x oversized PNG, not in a modern format.
findings.recommendation: Re-export as properly sized WebP/AVIF via the existing Vite asset pipeline.

findings.title: ~17KB unused CSS per page
findings.description: Shared base CSS bundle ships more rules than any single route needs, consistent across all 3 pages tested.
findings.recommendation: Verify Tailwind content purge globs cover all 15 HTML entry points; consider per-route CSS chunking.

findings.title: Short cache lifetimes on third-party chat-widget assets
findings.description: 8 third-party resources cache for only 4 hours, ~74KB re-download waste per repeat-visit cache miss.
findings.recommendation: Third-party controlled; reinforces the case for deferring/lazy-loading the widget instead.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt cleanly allows all AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.)
sitemap.xml current and correctly referenced
Server-rendered ProfessionalService JSON-LD gives non-JS crawlers a usable baseline summary

findings.title: Homepage and all niche pages are fully client-side rendered with an empty body as served
findings.description: OpenAI's, Anthropic's, and Perplexity's crawlers have little-to-no reliable JS execution, so the page is effectively text-empty on fetch for those platforms. This caps every other GEO dimension.
findings.recommendation: Statically pre-render each route - same fix as the Technical SEO Critical finding.

findings.title: No /llms.txt
findings.description: GET https://aplory.dev/llms.txt returns 404. Optional and doesn't affect Google, but is one of the few channels to hand non-JS crawlers a clean summary today.
findings.recommendation: Publish a plain-text llms.txt summarizing what APLORY is, who it serves, and key page links.

findings.title: No long-form, self-contained citable passages anywhere
findings.description: Optimal AI-citation passage length is ~134-167 words; every extractable answer block on the homepage falls well short (16-36 words).
findings.recommendation: Add 1-2 expanded 134-167 word paragraphs as prose content, not as FAQPage schema (no Google ranking benefit from the markup itself post-May-2026 retirement).

findings.title: Zero external brand/entity signals
findings.description: No Wikipedia entity, Reddit mentions, YouTube presence, or LinkedIn company page found. YouTube/Reddit presence correlates more strongly with AI citation than domain authority.
findings.recommendation: Build minimal external entity presence over time: demo/explainer video, LinkedIn company page, encourage early-customer mentions.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Hero images correctly sized with explicit width/height attributes (good CLS practice)
loading="eager" correctly applied to above-the-fold hero images

findings.title: logo-mark.png oversized and wrong format
findings.description: 400x81px PNG displayed at 196x40px (2x oversized), not in WebP/AVIF - 95% of its bytes are unnecessary.
findings.recommendation: Re-export as WebP/AVIF at correct dimensions.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add prerendering/SSG for the 11 CSR routes so real content ships in initial HTML
Resolve the voice-vs-text product-claim mismatch on all 9 vertical pages
De-duplicate the identical H2 across all 10 pages with vertical-specific headlines

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Defer/lazy-load the LeadConnector chat widget script
Consolidate font loading to one provider
Add missing security headers via netlify.toml
Add an About/Company section with founder, address, and PIB
Add 3-5 vertical-specific FAQ entries per niche page (prose, not schema)
Reformat and disclose the '62% of missed calls' statistic
Publish /llms.txt

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Localize 'How it works' step copy per vertical
Expand sta-radimo.html with mechanism/SLA/data-handling depth
Add directional trust proof (client count or quotes per vertical)
Publish minimal pricing/packaging
Add expanded 134-167 word citable paragraphs
Compress logo-mark.png to WebP/AVIF
Purge unused CSS (~17KB/page)
Begin Serbian-market link-building (Startit.rs, Product Hunt, PKS directories)
Add Organization schema with sameAs, image, and address

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console and a PageSpeed Insights API key
Add a free Moz API key to move backlink tracking to Tier 1
Verify mobile hamburger menu tap-target size in a real browser
Re-run the full audit after Phase 1-2 land
Set an SEO drift baseline
